description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'OrganisationMonetaryConfiguration' that sets up beans related to currency services within the Fineract project. It includes bean definitions for reading and writing currency data, and for managing organization currency information, with conditional instantiation based on existing beans.

classes.name: OrganisationMonetaryConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class providing bean definitions for currency-related services within the project.

methods.name: currencyReadPlatformService
methods.description: Provides a CurrencyReadPlatformService bean, initializing it with a JdbcTemplate if not already present.

methods.name: currencyWritePlatformService
methods.description: Provides a CurrencyWritePlatformService bean, creating an instance with multiple repository and service dependencies, if not already defined.

methods.name: organisationCurrencyReadPlatformService
methods.description: Provides an OrganisationCurrencyReadPlatformService bean, wrapping a CurrencyReadPlatformService implementation, if absent.
